## 1300 - 1341

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01300">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1300 CV - Unable to calculate correlation factor (mass is non-zero, calculated mass is zero)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01300">

This exception applies to Liquid Meter and Ticket data on import or an edit where the correlation factor is to be calculated.

When FLOWCAL attempts to calculate the mass correlation factor, if the provided mass is a non-zero value but FLOWCAL calculates 0 for mass, then this exception will be generated and the mass correlation factor will not be calculated.

For example, if a Liquid Volumetric meter ticket is imported with IV = 1000, MF = 0, and mass = 183309.9 and FLOWCAL calculates Meter Density = 0.5235 REL and mass = 0, then this exception will be generated because the imported mass is not zero and the calculated mass is 0.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01301">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1301 CV - Unable to calculate correlation factor (open TOV is non-zero, calculated open TOV is zero)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01301">

This exception applies to Tank Run and Vessel Tank Tickets on import or an edit where the correlation factor is to be calculated.

When FLOWCAL attempts to calculate the open TOV correlation factor, if the provided open TOV is a non-zero value but FLOWCAL calculates 0 for open TOV, then this exception will be generated and the open TOV correlation factor will not be calculated.

For example, if a Tank Run ticket is imported with open TOV = 0, but FLOWCAL calculates an open TOV of 50000 from the Open Level and Tank Capacity Table, then this exception will be generated because the imported open TOV is not zero and the calculated open TOV is 0.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01302">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01302">

When FLOWCAL attempts to calculate the close TOV correlation factor, if the provided close TOV is a non-zero value but FLOWCAL calculates 0 for close TOV, then this exception will be generated and the close TOV correlation factor will not be calculated.

For example, if a Tank Run ticket is imported with close TOV = 0, but FLOWCAL calculates an close TOV of 50000 from the Open Level and Tank Capacity Table, then this exception will be generated because the imported close TOV is not zero and the calculated close TOV is 0.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01303">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01303">

This exception applies to Tank Run and Vessel Tank Tickets on import or an edit where the correlation factor is to be calculated.

When FLOWCAL attempts to calculate the TOV correlation factor, if the provided TOV is a non-zero value but FLOWCAL calculates 0 for TOV, then this exception will be generated and the TOV correlation factor will not be calculated.

For example, if a Tank Run ticket is imported with Open TOV = 50000, Close TOV = 50000, and TOV = 500, then FLOWCAL will calculate a TOV of 00. Because the imported TOV is not zero and the calculated TOV is 0, this exception will be generated.
